scenes.text: He was admitted complaining that he could not sleep.
scenes.art_prompt: a rain-soaked city street at night in the 1970s, wet asphalt, lone streetlight

scenes.text: Doctors watched him for weeks. He never closed his eyes.
scenes.art_prompt: a cluttered detective's desk, photographs and folders under a green desk lamp

scenes.text: His body was healthy. His mind stayed sharp.
scenes.art_prompt: an old archive room lined with dusty files, narrow aisle, single bulb

scenes.text: He claimed he had not slept since a fever as a boy.
scenes.art_prompt: a fog-covered mountain trail where a path abruptly ends, cold light

scenes.text: No one ever found a cause - or a reason to disbelieve him.
scenes.art_prompt: a faded family photograph on a mantelpiece, one face scratched out

scenes.text: Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty car parked on a remote road at dusk, doors closed, unexplained
